row: I am an experienced, fellowship-trained, orthopedic surgeon specializing in arthroscopic surgery of the knee and shoulder, and joint replacement surgery of the hip, knee, and shoulder. This channel will address common issues I encounter in practice and answer questions patients often ask me.
